description: Inside a small cheese dairy with stone floors, a young woman in a white cap, white jacket and blue apron holds a fresh block of white curd over a large copper vat while whey drips back into the yellowish liquid below. In her other hand she holds a tiny measuring spoon. She looks at the curd, smiles and lowers it back into the liquid. Wooden cheese moulds are stacked on the left, shelves of round cheeses stand on the right, and a glass of whey and a cheesecloth lie in front.

taps.phrase: to lower curd into the vat
